name.en: L-corner singularity: harmonic field and separate smooth MMS

note.ja: 解析解 第4象限を除いた[-1,1]²、theta∈[0,3pi/2]、u=r^(2/3)sin(2theta/3)、解析Dirichlet。N8/16/32、graded map x→x max(|x|,|y|)。正方形sin(pi x)sin(pi y)を同Nのregular/warpedで別検査。角の解析解と勾配を要素求積し、一様格子と事前graded格子を同じ自由度で比べます。別の単位正方形でsin(πx)sin(πy)をregular/warped格子へ置き、特異性と歪みを分けます。 特異解に正方形のL2二次を要求しません。固定の事前graded写像でありAMRソフトではありません。条件数は推定で、任意歪みへの保証はしません。
note.en: Analytic reference L-shaped[-1,1]² minus quadrantIV, theta0..3pi/2, analytic Dirichlet harmonic corner field. N8/16/32, fixed map x→x max(|x|,|y|). Separate unit-square sine MMS uses regular/warped grids. Integrate the analytic corner field and gradient over elements, comparing uniform and a-priori graded meshes at matched DOFs. A separate unit-square sine MMS on regular/warped meshes separates singularity from distortion. No smooth-square L2 order is imposed on the singular field. Fixed a-priori grading is not an AMR engine. Conditioning is estimated; arbitrary distortion is not certified.
